description: Read-only project review using Gitx status/history and Git diffs. No Gitx AI calls.

review.prompt: Read gitx:review, then call mcp__p_gitx_project__inspect. Review the actual changed source and relevant test evidence. Use plugin_ui with plugin gitx to show progress in the panel and concrete findings in a card. Do not edit, stage, commit, fetch, push, or invoke Gitx AI. Distinguish observed defects from hypotheses and unrun checks.

status.description: Show Gitx status and recent history
status.prompt: Call mcp__p_gitx_project__inspect and show a concise working-tree summary through plugin_ui with plugin gitx and kind card. Do not change files or call additional AI providers.

session.started.text: Inspect changes using Gitx. Review does not modify the repository.
